schema:
CREATE TABLE Vessels (vessel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, vessel_name TEXT NOT NULL, is_active INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Inspections (inspection_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, vessel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, result_status TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (vessel_id) REFERENCES Vessels (vessel_id));
correct_query: SELECT v.vessel_id, v.vessel_name FROM Vessels AS v WHERE v.is_active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Inspections AS i WHERE i.vessel_id = v.vessel_id AND i.result_status = 'FAILED')

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Adds a spurious conjunct i.severity <> 'MINOR' inside the NOT EXISTS subquery, failing to exclude outer rows when the matching subquery row has severity = 'MINOR'.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT v.vessel_id, v.vessel_name FROM Vessels AS v WHERE v.is_active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Inspections AS i WHERE i.vessel_id = v.vessel_id AND i.result_status = 'FAILED' AND i.severity <> 'MINOR')

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Omits the status filter i.result_status = 'FAILED' inside the NOT EXISTS subquery, erroneously excluding outer rows that have only non-failed inspections.
